evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt to enable the `-Wmissing-noreturn` compiler warning flag across the build system.
rationale: Enables the `-Wmissing-noreturn` compiler warning flag project-wide and adds missing annotations to prevent static analysis false positives. As noted in the PR description, missing `[[noreturn]]` attributes can trigger compiler false positives such as spurious `-Wreturn-type` warnings.
